name: Workspace Icons
author: Fostik
description: Workspace indicators that show the logo of the app that opened on each workspace first

barWidget.description: Each workspace shows the logo of the app that opened there first, the workspace number, and how many other apps share it.

schema.label: Workspace numbers
schema.description: Show the workspace number in the corner of an occupied workspace.

schema.label: Extra app count
schema.description: Show +N when a workspace holds more apps than the one whose logo is drawn.

schema.label: Which app to show
schema.description: Pick the app that opened first on the workspace, or the one focused there most recently.
